output_text: Repo: https://github.com/clawdbot. GitHub issues/comments/PR comments: use literal multiline strings or `-F - <<'EOF'` (or $'...') for real newlines; never embed "\\n". Source: `src/` (CLI in `src/cli`, commands in `src/commands`, web provider `src/provider-web.ts`, infra `src/infra`, media `src/media`). Tests: colocated `*.test.ts`. Docs: `docs/` (images, queue, Pi config). Built output: `dist/`. Plugins/extensions: `extensions/*` workspace packages; keep plugin-only deps in extension `package.json`; do not add them to root `package.json` unless core uses them. Installers at https://clawd.bot/* from `../clawd.bot` (`public/install.sh`, `public/install-cli.sh`, `public/install.ps1`). Messaging: consider **all** built-in + extension channels when refactoring shared logic (routing, allowlists, pairing, command gating, onboarding, docs). Docs host Mintlify (docs.clawd.bot). Internal doc links: root-relative no `.md`/`.mdx` (e.g. `[Config](/configuration)`); section refs use anchors (e.g. `#hooks`). Peter links: full `https://docs.clawd.bot/...` URLs. Touch docs: end reply with referenced URLs. README GitHub: absolute docs URLs. Docs generic: no personal device names/hostnames/paths; placeholders like `user@gateway-host` and “gateway host”. Runtime baseline Node **22+** (keep Node + Bun paths working). Install deps: `pnpm install`; also `bun install` supported; keep `pnpm-lock.yaml` + Bun patching in sync when touching deps/patches.
